script.title: THE MYSTERY CHARGE
script.title_quote: You had my heart going there
script.story_hook: A customer spots a charge she doesn't know.
script.intro_zh: 一位顧客在帳單上，看到一筆陌生的費用。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today we question a strange phone bill charge. Listen for polite problem-solving calls.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！今天我們打電話詢問可疑帳單。留意有禮貌的處理問句。
script.outro: Charge gone, credit saved. See you next time!
script.outro_zh: 費用刪掉了，折帳也存好了。下次再見！
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each customer-service phrase.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在，我們逐句跟讀客服情境的說法。
script.char_a_description: a woman in her thirties with wavy shoulder-length auburn hair, wearing a mustard yellow cardigan, black leggings and wool socks, average build, seated at a kitchen table with a phone
script.char_b_description: a young man with a clean-shaven face and short straight black hair, wearing a gray headset, a light blue button shirt and gray slacks, tidy posture at a desk

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I have a question about my bill.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ hæv ə ˈkwɛstʃən əˈbaʊt maɪ bɪl/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我想請教帳單上的一個問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course! I'm Leo. May I have your name?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv ˈkɔɹs aɪm ˈlioʊ meɪ aɪ hæv jɔɹ neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題！我是里歐，敢問您的姓名？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anna Brooks. Account is… let me check.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈænə bɹʊks əˈkaʊnt ɪz lɛt mi tʃɛk/
dialogue.zh: 安娜．布魯克斯。帳號是……我看一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No rush. I can pull it by name.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɹʌʃ aɪ kæn pʊl ɪt baɪ neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 不急，我可以用姓名調出資料。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here it is. Six five, double seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹ ɪt ɪz sɪks faɪv ˈdʌbl̩ ˈsɛvən/
dialogue.zh: 有了。六五、兩個七。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. How can I help today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt haʊ kæn aɪ hɛlp təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 查到了。今天需要什麼幫忙？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's a charge called Stream Plus.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹz ə tʃɑɹdʒ kɔld stɹim plʌz/
dialogue.zh: 有一筆叫「影音加值」的費用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The nine ninety-nine one? Let's peek.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə naɪn ˈnɪnti naɪn wʌn lɛts pik/
dialogue.zh: 九塊九那筆嗎？我瞧一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes. I never signed up for that.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ ˈnɛvɚ saɪnd ʌp fɔɹ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 對，我從沒申請過這個服務。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, it says added on March third.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm ɪt sɛz əˈdɛd ɑn mɑɹθ θɜɹd/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，紀錄寫著三月三號加上的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: March third? I was out of town!
dialogue.phonetic: /mɑɹθ θɜɹd aɪ wʌz aʊt ʌv taʊn/
dialogue.zh: 三月三號？我那陣子根本不在家！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay. Was anyone else using your phone?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ wʌz ˈɛnɪˌwʌn ɛls ˈjuzɪŋ jʊɹ foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 了解。有別人用過你的手機嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um… my nephew visited that weekend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm maɪ ˈnɛvju ˈvɪzɪtð̩ ðæt ˈwikˌɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 呃……我外甥那個週末來住過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe he tried it and forgot to say?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi hi tɹaɪd ɪt ænd fɚˈɡɑt tə seɪ/
dialogue.zh: 說不定他試用了，卻忘了說一聲？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds exactly like him, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt saʊndz ɪɡˈzæktli laɪk hɪm ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，這太像他會做的事了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Common thing. So, remove it today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɑmən θɪŋ soʊ ɹɪˈmuv ɪt təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 這種事很常見。那今天就取消嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please. Can I also get the money back?
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz kæn aɪ ˈɔlsoʊ ɡɛt ðə ˈmʌni bæk/
dialogue.zh: 好。那已經扣的錢能退嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good question. Let me check the rules…
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈkwɛstʃən lɛt mi tʃɛk ðə ɹulz/
dialogue.zh: 問得好，我查一下退款規定……

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take your time. Um, still here!
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jʊɹ taɪm ʌm stɪl hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢來。呃，我還在線上！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry! One refund, and the add-on's gone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑɹi wʌn ɹɪˈfʌnd ænd ði əˈdɑnz ɡɑn/
dialogue.zh: 抱歉！可以退一筆，加值也會刪掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wonderful. Will it show on next bill?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwʌndɚfʊl wɪl ɪt ʃoʊ ɑn nɛkst bɪl/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。退款會顯示在下個帳單嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It'll appear as a small credit line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪtəl əˈpɪɹ əz ə smɑl ˈkɹɛdɪt laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 它會以一小行「折帳」出現。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Credit? Meaning it pays next month's bill?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɹɛdɪt ˈminɪŋ ɪt peɪz nɛkst mʌnθs bɪl/
dialogue.zh: 折帳？就是自動抵下個月的費用？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly. It comes right off your total.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ɪt kʌmz ɹaɪt ɑf jʊɹ ˈtoʊtl̩/
dialogue.zh: 一點就從總額裡直接扣掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that part is easy to explain.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæt pɑɹt ɪz ˈizi tə ɪkˈspleɪn/
dialogue.zh: 噢，這樣講我就懂了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now, one more line caught my eye.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ wʌn mɔɹ laɪn kɑt maɪ aɪ/
dialogue.zh: 另外，還有一行引起了我的注意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What? There's another one? Really?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ðɛɹz əˈnʌðɚ wʌn ˈɹɪli/
dialogue.zh: 什麼？還有一筆問題嗎？真的假的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, this part's good news, relax.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðɪs pɑɹts ɡʊd nuz ɹɪˈlæks/
dialogue.zh: 不，這筆是好消息，放輕鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Phew. You had my heart going there.
dialogue.phonetic: /fju ju hæd maɪ hɑɹt ˈɡoʊɪŋ ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 呼，你剛剛嚇得我心臟狂跳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha. See, your rate dropped to thirty-eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ si jʊɹ ɹeɪt dɹɑpt tə ˈθɜɹti‿eɪt/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，看，你的月費已經降到三十八。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: From forty-five? When did that happen?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɹʌm ˈfɔɹti faɪv wɛn dɪd ðæt ˈhæpən/
dialogue.zh: 從四十五降的？什麼時候的事？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Last fall, with a plan-change notice.
dialogue.phonetic: /læst fɔl wɪð ə plæn tʃeɪnjs ˈnoʊtɪs/
dialogue.zh: 去年秋天，隨著方案變更通知生效的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I think I read that very fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk aɪ ɹɛd ðæt ˈvɛɹi fæst/
dialogue.zh: 那封信我好像一眼掃過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most people don't catch it. That's fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst ˈpipəl̩ doʊnt kætʃ ɪt ðæts faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 大多數人都沒注意到，沒關係。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So my real bill is… what now?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ maɪ ɹiəl bɪl ɪz wʌt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 那我實際該繳的……是多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With the refund, you're owed eleven twenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪð ðə ɹɪˈfʌnd jʊɹ ɑwd ɪˈlɛv̩n ˈtwɛnti/
dialogue.zh: 算上退款，你應該拿回十一塊二。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eleven twenty, and it goes to next month?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈlɛv̩n ˈtwɛnti ænd ɪt ɡoʊz tə nɛkst mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 十一塊二，直接留到下個月？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep. Or a check, if you ask by Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp ɔɹ ə tʃɛk ɪf ju æsk baɪ ˈfɹaɪdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 對。或是週五前申請，寄支票給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Credit is fine. Checks feel so old-school.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɹɛdɪt ɪz faɪn tʃɛks fil soʊ ˈoldˈskul/
dialogue.zh: 折帳就好，支票感覺太老派了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair enough. Done and done, all set.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ ɪˈnʌf dʌn ænd dʌn ɔl sɛt/
dialogue.zh: 合理。兩件事都辦好了，沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You were faster than I feared.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju wɜɹ ˈfæstɚ ðæn aɪ fɪɹd/
dialogue.zh: 你可比我預想的快多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry about the hold, by the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑɹi əˈbaʊt ðə hoʊd baɪ ðə weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 對了，剛剛讓你在線上等，抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, the music wasn't bad. Two good songs.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðə ˈmjuzɪk ˈwɑznt bæd tu ɡʊd sɔŋz/
dialogue.zh: 噢，等待音樂還不錯，兩首好歌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! We're proud of that jingle, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ wɪɹ pɹaʊd ɑv ðæt ˈdʒɪŋɡəl̩ ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 哈！說真的，我們還挺以那段鈴聲為傲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last thing — how do I prevent this?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn læst θɪŋ haʊ du aɪ pɹɪˈvɛnt ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 最後一個問題——這種加值怎麼防範？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn on add-on alerts inside the app.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜɹn ɑn əˈdɑn əˈlɜɹts ɪnˈsaɪd ði æp/
dialogue.zh: 在App裡打開「加值提醒」。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Alerts — like text messages? Are they free?
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈlɜɹts laɪk tɛkst ˈmɛsɪdʒɪz ɑɹ ðeɪ fɹi/
dialogue.zh: 提醒？像簡訊那種嗎？免費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free, and instant. Want me to switch it on?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɹi ænd ˈɪnstənt wɑnt mi tə swɪtʃ ɪt ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 免費又即時。要我幫你打開嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes please. And email me the receipt.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliz ænd ˈimeɪl mi ðə ɹɪˈsit/
dialogue.zh: 麻煩你了。再把收據寄我電子郵件。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's on the way. Anything else today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ɑn ðə weɪ ˈɛnɪθɪŋ ɛls təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 已經寄出了。今天還有別的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I set up auto-pay too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ sɛt ʌp ˈɔɾoʊ‿peɪ tu/
dialogue.zh: 我該不該也設自動繳費？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart idea. It sends a reminder first.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt aɪˈdiə ɪt sɛndz ə ɹɪˈmaɪndɚ fɜɹst/
dialogue.zh: 好主意，扣款前它會先發提醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You really thought of everything, huh.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈɹɪli θɔt ɑv ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ hʌ/
dialogue.zh: 你真的什麼都替我想到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's a phone plan, not rocket science.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ə foʊn plæn nɑt ˈɹɑkɪt ˈsaɪəns/
dialogue.zh: 只是個手機方案，不難的啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noted with thanks. Have a good shift.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊtɪd wɪθ θæŋks hæv ə ɡʊd ʃɪft/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，非常感謝。祝你值班順利。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same to you! Watch for that credit.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm tə ju wɑtʃ fɔɹ ðæt ˈkɹɛdɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你也一樣！記得留意那筆折帳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll check next month's bill tonight, bye.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl tʃɛk nɛkst mʌnθs bɪl təˈnaɪt baɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我今晚就研究下個月的帳單，拜拜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye! And tell your nephew the trial's over.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ænd tɛl jʊɹ ˈnɛvju ðə ˈtɹaɪəlz ˈoʊvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 拜拜！替你外甥帶話，試用期結束囉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, I will. We need a good talk.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ aɪ wɪl wi nid ə ɡʊd tɔk/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我會的。我們姑侄要好好談談。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks for calling, Anna. Take care!
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fɔɹ ˈkɔlɪŋ ˈænə teɪk kɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你的來電，安娜。再見！

script.youtube_title: 【📱「我沒訂這個服務！」】🎧60句查帳單聽力實境｜確認身分・不明加值・退款折帳｜💡不用背多聽就會用｜🌱A2｜Questioning a Phone Bill Charge
script.youtube_title_en: "You Had My Heart Going There" — Questioning a Phone Bill Charge
script.youtube_description:
60句詢問帳單費用的聽力練習：手機帳單冒出一筆沒申請過的加值費，打電話該怎麼查、怎麼退、怎麼防？

這一集跟著安娜撥打客服電話，從報帳號、核對姓名開始，查出一筆影音加值的來歷，學會退款、折帳、加值提醒與自動繳費的說法，還把月費降價的意外好消息收入囊中。

你會聽到：
- 開場求助：「Hi, I have a question about my bill.」
- 核對帳戶：「Account is… let me check.」
- 退款與折帳：「It comes right off your total.」
- 客服情境的禮貌應對：「Want me to switch it on?」

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，把這些句子聽熟、說順。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱頻道，每週都有生活情境英文聽力！
script.youtube_description_en:
60 lines of phone-bill listening practice: a customer calls her carrier about a mystery add-on called Stream Plus, verifies the account, discovers a nephew's forgotten free trial, and learns words like refund, credit line, alerts and auto-pay.

You will hear how to open a service call, confirm your identity, question a charge politely, ask for money back, and lock the door behind it with app alerts. The second half is line-by-line listening and shadowing.

Made for A2 learners: no memorizing, just listen until it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for daily-life English listening videos every week.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
帳單上多出一筆沒見過的費用，該打哪支電話？
退款會進帳單還是支票？加值怎麼防止偷偷續費？

這一集帶大家坐到安娜的廚房桌前，撥一通客服電話，從核對帳號到刪掉加值、拿到折帳，把處理帳單的每一步都聽懂。

你會聽到：
💳 開場求助：「Hi, I have a question about my bill.」
🔎 追問來歷：「I never signed up for that.」
🧾 退款折帳：「It comes right off your total.」

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習 🎧 先把整段對話聽熟，再一句一句開口模仿，讓句子自然變成口語習慣。

願你每張帳單，都清清楚楚。
script.thumbnail_action: pointing at a phone bill line
